resource.name: BasicCardiacCheckupPlan
resource.title: Basic Cardiac Checkup Plan
resource.description: Draft FHIR R4 order-set PlanDefinition based on the SIMS Hospitals Basic Cardiac Checkup Package page. The page lists CBC with ESR, fasting and post-prandial blood sugar, HbA1c, renal function, lipid profile, uric acid, ECG, chest X-ray, ECHO/TMT, cardiologist consultation, and diet counselling. The page does not specify whether ECHO and TMT are alternatives or both included; validate the package and clinical selection rules with the hospital before production use.
resource.purpose: Group ServiceRequest-producing activities for the Basic Cardiac Checkup package.
